stem: How are the ideas about recycling in the selection “Rewards for Recycling” DIFFERENT from the ideas in the selection “Laws for Less Trash”?

options.label: A
options.text: “Rewards for Recycling” shows that families work together to recycle.

options.label: B
options.text: “Rewards for Recycling” shows that recycling can be both helpful and harmful.

options.label: C
options.text: “Rewards for Recycling” says that recycling should help people as well as the planet.

options.label: D
options.text: “Rewards for Recycling” says that everyone needs to recycle.
